definition: A planet's house position sets how strongly and quickly it acts. Angular planets are loud and active; cadent planets are quiet and slow.

angular.effect: Strong, prominent, fast to manifest. Events 'happen'.

cadent.effect: Weaker, more mental or transitional, slow to externalize.

appUsage: Weight a placement or transit UP when the planet is angular, DOWN when cadent. An angular transit is a headline; a cadent one is background. Combine with dignity: angular + dignified is the strongest signal, cadent + debilitated the weakest.
summary: Angularity weights how strongly and quickly a planet acts by house position.
